テキスト cha 605: Born Shiyo 757, May 27. Height 155cm. Eiichiro Niimura's older twin brother. He looks exactly like his younger brother, but his personality seems somewhat different; he treats guests with a confident manner.
Perhaps he dislikes trouble: when he is about to be dragged into the women's battle, he swiftly gets up and retreats to his room.

Seeing Erina Goto agonizing over the series of baffling events in the Arata settlement, Haruka Niimura introduces Kotaro Niimura as backup. Like Erina Goto, he seems good at logical thinking; he explains in detail how to think things through, impressing even Erina.

He appears with the residents before the Motoki-cho group as they try to escape the Arata settlement. Holding the half-dead Kogori couple hostage, he urges Natsumi Kogori to come over to him. But he is gravely wounded by Kana Niimura, who has used Droga, and then his arm is cut off by his mother, Erika Niimura. Why he was so set on Natsumi Kogori, and why he called her a witch and a divine messenger, is unknown.

Under Erina Goto's questioning, he confesses that he still makes Droga. It is for self-defense against the curse-killings, he says, and has never been used. By his account, Erika Niimura, Chigaya Niimura and Kana Niimura do not know Droga is still being made, and if Erika found out, she would be furious at him for breaking the rules.

He injects himself with Droga and tries to capture Natsumi Kogori and to kill Haruka Niimura and Erina Goto. Knocking Kana Niimura unconscious and handling the resisting Haruka like a doll, he had clearly gained inhuman strength. Just before finishing Haruka off, he revealed that Natsumi and Haruka are real sisters, which suggests he truly meant to kill her. When Erina Goto pressed him for the truth of the curse-killings, he brushed her off, saying he did it all himself. But that does not hold together, and Erina guesses that he is covering for someone.

Because Erina Goto had switched the keys on him, he was left behind on the far side of the iron-barred door. He hacked at the door with his nata with all his might to break it down, but the vibrations broke the fragile ground, and the blossoming cherry tree of the Niimura main house, standing right above, fell into the underground space. Pinned beneath it, he could not move, and when he was rescued he only kept repeating things as if out of his mind.

To treat Kana Niimura, who was suddenly struck by murderous intent toward Sakura Niimura, he finds Kana, who had gone missing, and gives her falsificaso. In the middle of it, he is attacked by bloodthirsty residents and dies.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 605: In Shiyo 790, just before the Megasawa City case, Chigaya Niimura is seized by the urge to kill, and he gets as far as finding that giving her falsificaso would treat it. But to test whether a drug recorded in writings decades old was truly harmless, he sent Mifuyu Niimura Droga along with falsificaso as an antidote. In Shiyo 800, upon Mifuyu's arrest, he is indicted for his involvement in the Megasawa City case.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 605: Under the 'Blessing' given off by the Verde mummy, his constitution changes to that of the fourth generation, and he becomes obsessed with the Verde mummy. In time he loses his human functions and becomes a new cherry embryo.

In middle school, to end the bullying of Sakura Niimura, he joins the gang himself and tries to break it up from the inside. He succeeds by spreading false rumors, but around then he also foresees bullying from other schools. He tells his younger brother Eiichiro Niimura, "Do what only you can do: stay by Sakura Niimura's side."

In Shiyo 790, just before the Megasawa City case, Chigaya Niimura is seized by the urge to kill, and he gets as far as finding that giving her falsificaso should treat it. But to test whether a drug recorded in literature from decades ago is really harmless to use, he sends falsificaso, as an antidote, together with Droga to Mifuyu Niimura.

After the thirteenth-year memorial service, while the exhausted others sleep, he goes alone to the underground storeroom to mourn Sakura Niimura. Afraid of losing the dead Sakura, he obeyed her, back as a divine messenger, left Chigaya Niimura's green eye untreated, and ignored the truth of the curse-killings. He burned the storehouse's books to hide that the dead walk, but Shigatsu Youka already ruled the dead, and he sees he was trapped. To fight back, he hid in the storeroom to give Natsumi Kogori falsificaso, but with Chigaya also given Droga, he treated her instead, foiling Shigatsu Youka.

Afraid that his beloved wife would truly vanish, he covered up everything about the curse-killings. Realizing he can never see his wife again, he wails like a child, but his daughter Chigaya Niimura takes it head-on.
